correctness.rationale: Exact cooperative cut flux is derived from the stated ODE. Reflecting initial order forces a nonpositive mean and comparison with the unbiased chain. Its first eigenfunction has positive projection for every nondegenerate one-sided start and positive prefixes, yielding eventual strict stochastic comparison to uniform. The discrete parabola is a positive subsolution in cumulative variables, preventing the negative mean from returning to zero. A positive-coefficient factorization proves that every frozen chain with negative non-endpoint mean has a still more negative stationary mean. A limsup argument forces convergence to the left endpoint for all k; reflection handles the other side; delta at zero is explicitly excluded and checked. Finite exact tests verify key identities but are not substituted for the general proof.

originality.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper explicitly presents the one-sided initial-support conclusion as a numerically motivated expectation, not a theorem. Its existing near-endpoint sufficient mean criterion does not cover distributions arbitrarily concentrated at zero with a small mass below it. Comparable titles were inspected at the microscopic rule level: direction-toward-neighbor voting differs from the absolute-opinion-biased Cao–Gong process. Related previous results for this same mean-field model concern unstable spectrum or conditional convergence rates and do not select initial basins. Targeted mathematical-record and literature queries yielded no direct implication-equivalent coverage. General monotone McKean–Vlasov theory remains a residual historical-priority risk, not claimed to be exhaustively excluded.

value.rationale: The mathematical gap is explicitly singled out as an expected but unproved one-sided basin classification in arXiv:2605.28984v1 §4. It is a natural infinitely parametrized basin-selection result, strictly beyond the authors’ near-extreme mean hypotheses and beyond local-instability or conditional-rate results. The proof establishes an explanatory order/spectral/frozen-chain mechanism and precisely states which mixed-sign basins remain unsolved.
